session.finalMessage:
Fixed all six reported issues in `serialize.ts` using function expressions and an explicit converter callback.

Type checking and serialization checks passed, including cyclic references. Full lint still reports existing, unrelated `any` and inline-comment errors. Only `serialize.ts` changed.

mutualRecursion: The helpers call each other recursively, so declaration order needs care.
I changed the helpers to accept the value converter as an argument, which removes the circular declaration dependency.
I’m verifying lint, types, and recursive serialization behavior.
whyOrder: The helpers call each other recursively, so declaration order needs care.
preserveBehaviour: I’ll read the file and rule guidance, then make the smallest change that preserves behavior and verify the lint results.
restructure: Full lint still reports existing, unrelated `any` and inline-comment errors.
